scope: LR24-F-Mini only; compact FC carrier and one plain rail-mounted navigation/radio accessory plate. Deliberately removable servo/input module preserved.
intentional_changes: Remove LR900-A profile, native identity, connector evidence and unreferenced dimension image. Select LR24-F-Mini onboard with LR24-F on ground; retain unknown installed antenna, wiring and adhesive interfaces.

ElectronicsMount retains only the FC support cross, integral rail shoe and optical-host anchors. Rail-axis length decreases from 141.4853 to 64.9706 mm; FC pose and 8 mm underside wiring reservation remain unchanged.

Add one 34x78x2 mm plain accessory deck with integral rail shoe and one ordinary M2x8/hex-nut rail clamp. Keep two confirmed P-AS mounting holes. GPS alternatives and Mini use uninterrupted 18x14 and 22x14 mm adhesive allocations, respectively; no model-shaped pockets or dedicated radio/GPS arms.

All navigation choices share accessory-local (14,-24) mm; Mini is at (14,24) mm. Default accessory station X=-158 mm, yaw180, preserves conservative direct-helix clearance for both optical hosts/sensors. This position is 4 mm from the -162 mm rail land centre, not a claim of +/-4 mm additional trim.

Separate FC and accessory local frames for references, reservations, native properties and validation. Four rail carriers still form propulsion/battery/electronics mass regions. Preserve 29 existing control responses and add three accessory controls.

13 installed printed parts, 3 coupons, 14 unique print exports and 60 modeled hardware items. Compared with AS this adds one integral plate/shoe and one standard clamp pair; no claim of reduced total material or part count.

independent_transition_audit.scope: AS committed fixture to AT candidate, full shape/native/metadata deltas and explicit canonical origin basis review. Original fixture available in previous Git commit. Candidate promoted only after independent approval; final build changes fingerprint for its configured fixture path/hash.

physical_limits: PA12 fit prototype only; printed flatness, loaded deflection, adhesion, connector installation, RF performance and physical qualification remain unverified.

Rail pads are short attachment wings around a raised sliding head, not a verified continuous flat electronics mounting face. The accessory plate supplies a geometric face; device underside components and heat dissipation still constrain actual tape contact.

MG-F10 direct helix downward mechanical envelope is not outdoor reception qualification. Remote upward antenna placement, cable and mounting remain unmodeled. Repositioning the accessory requires renewed clearance checks.

Retain FC input-voltage evidence conflict and unmeasured shared BEC headroom. Mini 2 W is maximum-average reference, not peak demand. FC/P-AS final mounting stacks and real cable lengths remain unresolved.
Extra accessory rail clamp uses the existing long-leg L-key service method. The short-leg insertion sweep collides with the plain deck and is not an accepted method.
visual_review_scope: Full assembly, compact FC, plain accessory deck in assembly, print layout and both optical hosts inspected. Purchased-device solids are nominal envelopes; actual harnesses and adhesive retention are not modeled.

mass_comparison.scope: BRep-volume estimates at assumed material densities, not weighed mass. The reference equipment subtotal changes by selecting Mini instead of LR900-A; this is not a measured weight reduction. Battery, wiring, antenna and unmodeled mounting items remain excluded.

native_tests.command: FreeCAD bundled Python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
native_tests.verification_basis: Full native suite followed by successful targeted rerun of two corrected test fixtures. CAD source remained unchanged; this is not a claim that the initial full run passed.

changes: Add AccessoryMount to the explicit expected saved inventory.
Include AccessoryMount in the manufacturing scratch document and assert new FC/plate probe names and 2 mm sections instead of removed navigation/radio arm sections.

blender_review.scope: All exported integer-frame native samples, exact CAD-part inventories and visibility, and scene object/action isolation. CAD millimetres become metres with a global X half-turn. Quaternion sign continuity is checked between samples. No continuous-time interpolation, collision, physics, or source-CAD freshness certification is claimed.
